offering.description: Must exactly match the Offering name you register in the ACP dashboard.

endpoint.description: The PulseNetwork endpoint that fulfills this offering.

query.description: Maps the endpoint's query params to templates. '{field}' = required from the buyer's requirement JSON; '{field|default}' = optional with a fallback; anything else is literal.

required.description: Requirement fields the buyer MUST supply; a missing one auto-rejects the job.

wholesale.description: What the upstream call costs you (informational; used to show your margin).

retail.description: What you charge the buyer on ACP. Should match the dashboard price.
